page.heading: Document templates
page.description: The wording of your reservation agreements, contracts and receipts. Edit the document directly — or its HTML — and check it with sample data and your company's legal details before saving.

status.defaultHint: Save a version to use your own wording.

placeholders.title: Placeholders
placeholders.hint: Click one to insert it where the cursor is in the document. Each is replaced with the deal's value when a document is generated.
placeholders.hintPreview: Switch to Document or HTML to insert placeholders.

preview.title: Preview with sample data
preview.hint: Scripts don't run in templates, and images must be embedded (data: URLs); links to other sites aren't loaded.

toasts.saved: Saved as version {{version}}. New documents use it from now on.
toasts.reset: Back to the built-in default. Your versions are kept.

templates.font: Font: {{font}}, the app's font — documents are printed in it

visual.hint: Click into the document and type. Highlighted chips are placeholders, filled in from the deal; amber chips mark conditions and repeated rows — keep a condition's start and end together.
